title: A certificate format for universal reachability claims
statement: "Every 4-bit permutation is reachable in <=15 gates" quantifies over 10^13 objects; one DRAT per instance is off by thirteen orders of magnitude. Needed: a streaming BFS-closure transcript with a checkable frontier invariant and a cardinality check. Pilot on M.riscv.table22 (known answer). Effort estimate: months.
